messages:
eva: quick heads up — we plan to unpin SDK 3.2 for eu-west tonight 23:00 PT but we discovered a kernel/quant mismatch for qv2-legacy models that requires a runtime sticky pin until a microkernel lands. Need coordination on rollout window and rollback triggers.
mike: ok, thanks. proposal: stagger SDK unpin for non-qv2 traffic first, leave runtime pinned for model-group:qv2-legacy. doable? :thinking_face:
jen: +1 staggered approach. please add a holdlist for the qv2 models and set deploy-bot to route those to runtime 2.14.1 explicitly. Also we need clear telemetry for perf regressions.
lucas: i can add the holdlist and update routing. quick command I'll run in ops CLI:```opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --type model --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z```
jen: perfect. can you also pin the runtime variant? e.g. runtime:2.14.1+kvcache-enabled as a fallback for qv2?
lucas: yes. adding runtime sticky pin now, will chat with infra for capacity reservation.
sre-ops: re: capacity, we'll reserve two canary pods in eu-west-1 and one in eu-central for warmup. set health checks to 200req/1s initially. i'll attach the runbook in comments. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Target audience: non-qv2 models. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Rollout: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m.
mike: rollout plan sounds good. rollback criteria: 1) 5xx rate increases > 0.5% over baseline for any model group 2) p95 generation latency regresses by > 30% for qv2-legacy after routing change 3) increased token-error-rate or OOMs. if hit any, abort and re-pin SDK.
je n: add one more: eval-quality drift on core prompts > 4% (we'll run a small prompt set every 5m) — automated alert to #incidents if triggered.
sre-ops: confirmed. i will create the monitoring queries and set alert thresholds. suggest a 20m cooldown before rolling to next slice.
lucas: runtime pin committed. opsctl output:```OK: runtime pin created id=pin-8392 target=runtime:2.14.1+kvcache scope=model-group:qv2-legacy expires=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z```
jen: add release notes blurb for the public changelog and internal release-notes doc. add this under Known Issues: "qv2-legacy models temporarily routed to runtime v2.14.1 due to quant kernel mismatch; SDK 3.2 unpin staged for non-qv2 traffic."
eva: i'll draft the release notes and include rollback guidance. mike — want me to call out cost/latency impact?
mike: yes, include expected p95 bump ~10-15% for qv2 group while pinned, and note potential increased GPU utilization. keep it transparent.
deploy-bot: note: escape hatch command available:```deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason "telemetry-trigger"```
jen: small ops checklist before 23:00: 1) confirm holdlist present (lucas) 2) runtime pin active (lucas) 3) canary pods healthy (sre-ops) 4) metrics + eval alerts configured (sre-ops) 5) release notes drafted (eva) 6) on-call alerted (mike)
lucas: checklist done except canary health, waiting on warmup — will update when green.
sre-ops: warming canaries now, ETA 9m. will post status.
eva: thanks — i'll publish internal note to #releases once deploy-bot confirms start. :rocket:
deploy-bot: info: SDK unpin job started (slice 10%). canary health: eu-west-1 pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. monitoring: linked.
mike: monitoring looks clean so far. keep an eye on p95 and token-error-rate.
sre-ops: pod-2 healthy, moving to 40% in 15m per plan. ready to abort if alerts hit.
je n: if we need to rollback, also remember to update customer-facing docs and notify support. who owns that?
eva: i'll ping CS and support with a succinct note and a playbook.
lucas: quick postmortem note for tomorrow: root cause tracked to quant kernel selection mismatch in runtime optimization pass — patch queued.
mike: thanks all. final note: after SDK unpin completes, schedule a small compatibility smoke for other model groups in 48h before full global unpin.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. No rollback triggered.
